task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Qiskit with dynamic circuits: encode RY(2.432)|0>, apply an X error on qubit 0, extract the syndrome with two ancillas, correct with if_test, and verify the decoded statistics over 4096 shots. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
